requirements.exclusion: Icon rendering support is client-internal capability with no wire footprint; the conditional premise (that the client renders icons) is equally invisible. Same reasoning as BASE-022 at 2025-11-25.

source.quote: `image/png` - PNG images (safe, universal compatibility) `image/jpeg` (and `image/jpg`) - JPEG images (safe, universal compatibility) Clients that support rendering icons SHOULD also support:

requirements.exclusion: Extends the same client-internal rendering-support premise as the MUST above it; neither the support nor its absence reaches the wire.

source.quote: Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise:

requirements.exclusion: The umbrella for consumer-side icon hygiene (fetch policy, size limits, origin checks) — all consumer-internal conduct after the recorded session ends. Same reasoning as BASE-023 at 2025-11-25.

source.quote: Clients MUST reject icon URIs that use unsafe schemes and redirects, such as `javascript:`, `file:`, `ftp:`, `ws:`, or local app URI schemes.

requirements.exclusion: Rejection is client-side handling after receipt; the trace records the icon metadata served, not what the client did with it. Same reasoning as BASE-024 at 2025-11-25.
